name: A Long Flight [SANDBOX]
desc:
[EARLY ACCESS GAME]

You're stranded in the middle of a vast, abandoned desert. Nothing surrounds you but endless sand, forgotten places, and an old airplane waiting to take flight.

✈️ Repair your aircraft, collect fuel, start your engine, and take off into the unknown.

🔧 Search abandoned locations, discover useful supplies, and keep your airplane in working condition.

🌍 Explore a massive world filled with unexpected discoveries, dangerous locations, and endless opportunities.

🔥 Face the challenges of the desert, manage your resources, and do whatever it takes to survive.

🧭 Choose your own direction, explore the skies, and see how far your journey takes you.

Your mission: Keep your airplane flying, explore the unknown, and survive as long as possible. Every flight could be your last.

Press M to start the engine.

✨ USE CODE: 5MVISITS

⚠️ The game is still in development, so you may encounter bugs.

llm.loop: stranded in a desert -> scavenge abandoned places for parts and fuel -> repair and fly an old plane -> explore further while managing hunger and stamina
llm.objectives: keep your airplane flying and survive as long as possible
llm.progression: distance travelled, plane condition, tokens, skins
llm.instructions: repair aircraft, collect fuel, start engine (M), take off, scavenge, survive
unique: 'A Dusty Trip' formula with a plane instead of a car
llm.thumbnails: rusty biplane in a hangar and on a desert road
llm.complexity_notes: procedural/long desert world, plane physics, repair systems
